title: cse-coach grounded-solutions contract
description: The verbatim-slice data contract emitted by scripts/export_showcase.py from the hand-curated dashboard/showcase.yml manifest, and consumed by the progressiveoverflow.com algorithm visualizers. Unlike progress.json (aggregate stats, never solution code), this file DELIBERATELY carries a curated, byte-identical slice of real solution code — one attempt per (lcNumber, variant), each segment's `lines` read straight off the file on disk (CRLF/LF-normalized) with its real source line numbers, so the site can render code that is provably identical to what is in the repo instead of a hand-pasted, driftable copy. schemaVersion is bumped on any breaking change so a viewer can refuse an incompatible file. The manifest is validated against the live source by `export_showcase.py --check`; a manifest-selected symbol that is renamed or deleted is a hard failure there, never a silent drift.

entries.description: One entry per (lcNumber, variant) picked in dashboard/showcase.yml.

entry.description: One curated attempt: the join key the site uses is `${lcNumber}:${variant}` (== `key`, derived, never re-parsed).

key.description: `${lcNumber}:${variant}` — the manifest's own join key, precomputed here so the site never has to re-derive it.

variant.description: Kebab-case approach id from the manifest's `variant` field — never a date. Matches the site's SolutionVariant.variant.

title.description: Problem title, preferring the solution file's own docstring header over the tracker (links.resolve_title_url) — null only if neither source has one.

url.description: Canonical LeetCode/NeetCode URL, same precedence as `title`. null for the rare problem with neither a header nor a tracker URL — the site's leetCodeUrlFor() falls back to a search URL.

file.description: Repo-root-relative path to the solution file (dashboard/showcase.yml's `file:` when given, else the unique file discovered for lcNumber).

symbol.description: The picked def (or class, for a design problem) — the manifest's own `symbol` field.

attemptDate.description: ISO date parsed from the symbol's own `_YYYYMMDD` suffix, else from an `Attempt · YYYY-MM-DD` banner comment directly above it, else null for an undated legacy def.

segments.description: The verbatim slice, in source order (sorted by startLine): an optional single-line `container` segment (the wrapping `class Solution:` header — absent when the manifest's `container` is explicitly null, i.e. a design problem where the symbol IS the class), exactly one `attempt` segment (the picked def/class, its leading `#`-comment banner folded into the same segment, through its last body line), and zero or more `helper` segments (extra module-level symbols named in the manifest's `helpers` list).

symbol.description: The class/def name this segment came from.

startLine.description: 1-based source line number in `file`, on GitHub's own line numbering (LF-normalized) — usable directly as a `#L<n>` anchor.

lines.description: The segment's source lines, verbatim and EOL-stripped, `lines[i]` == source line `startLine + i`. Byte-identical to what GitHub serves for this file, never re-indented or re-flowed.
